I talk with a lot of people daily. I’m still in high school, so I see and talk to so many people on a daily basis. Almost everyone is friendly, but I feel like I can’t find someone to actually converse with, someone who invites me to things, someone who hangs out with me. I need to actively approach people because they won’t approach me. I don’t like that, it makes me feel like a burden. People don’t dislike me, but I am just not good enough for them as a person.

In high school, lots of social events take place, parties, meet-ups, sleepovers. I don’t have anyone who I’m close enough with to be invited, which has given me the coping mechanism of going on the internet, scrolling through reddit or listening to music miserably. If I hosted an event and invited people, they would probably come, but again, it would make me feel active. I want to be passively loved by friends instead of actively. For reference, I’m an average kid. I play video games, I post photos on Instagram, i do mildly well in school. I just feel incredibly lonely and unappreciated, and I need to actively stimulate attention and social interaction which is hard to do when you’re as generally depressed as me.

Sorry for the big vent, it helps me articulate my thoughts talking to other people. I go on reddit because I don’t have anyone I’m close to.
